page.overview:
Who is Calamospondylus?

is an extinct genus of oviraptorid theropod dinosaur that lived in England during the Early Cretaceous period.

Calamospondylus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of the Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. It is shown as a megalosaur instead of an oviraptorosaur.
